title: Local OpenAI-compatible API (raw)
description: Any server with the OpenAI API (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses): a LiteLLM gateway, LocalAI, text-generation-webui, your own; only its address is opened, nothing else.

de.title: Lokale OpenAI-kompatible API (roh)
de.description: Jeder Server mit der OpenAI-API (/v1/chat/completions, /v1/responses): ein LiteLLM-Gateway, LocalAI, text-generation-webui, Ihr eigener; nur seine Adresse ist offen, sonst nichts.

llm.label: OpenAI-compatible server (sandbox-ai llm list), NAME or NAME:MODEL
llm.hint: sandbox-ai llm add api --kind openai-compatible --url http://192.168.1.20:4000 --model MODEL

notes: Register it once: sandbox-ai llm add api --kind openai-compatible --url URL (its root, a path prefix of a gateway included; a trailing /v1 is dropped), --api-key-secret SECRET for its key.

OpenCode needs /v1/chat/completions, Codex /v1/responses. Claude Code speaks only the Anthropic Messages API: it works only with a server that offers /v1/messages, registered with sandbox-ai llm add NAME ... --anthropic (a start of Claude with another one is refused).

NAME:MODEL picks a model (sandbox-ai llm models NAME lists them); without it the server's default (llm add --model) or its only one. sandbox-ai llm check NAME --agent AGENT asks the server whether it has the API that agent needs.

On this host's loopback (http://127.0.0.1:PORT) only with Podman: sandbox-ai opens that one port for the sandbox, and the server must listen on 127.0.0.1. In your LAN or tailnet: a private address, or https.
The agent reaches nothing but the server (--no-provider-defaults): no cloud provider, its login is not copied in; the server's key stays with the connection proxy.
